name: Futakami Youko
source: The student council president of [url=/c58417]Masaharu's[/url] school. Her first meeting with Masaharu was during his entrance ceremony when she gave him flowers and fixed his tie. Despite her refined appearance and "perfect" personality, she is quite mischievous. She loves especially to tease and play around with Masaharu, who gets very easily embarrassed. Youko knows a lot about sex and everything related to it however she has no experience to speak of.
